description: Three managers cover everything pinned in this repo:
github-actions -- the five SHA-pinned action refs in .github/workflows/ci.yml
mise           -- uv, hk, actionlint, gitleaks, zizmor, pinact and the Revyl
CLI in mise.toml
pep621         -- pillow/numpy plus the pytest+ruff dev group in pyproject.toml,
with uv.lock refreshed alongside
Blink's CLI is the one pin no manager covers: it ships from the vendor's own
CDN with no repository, tag or registry entry, so there is nothing to query.
`Scripts/update-blink-pin.sh` is its bump path; the rule below keeps Renovate
from guessing at it should its mise manager ever learn the `http` backend.
The Revyl CLI is NOT in that boat -- it is a `github:` backend pin, which the
mise manager reads as github-releases on RevylAI/revyl-cli. Its two documented
gaps for that backend are `tag_regex` and `version_prefix`, and the pin uses
neither, so no override is needed here. The `matching_regex` and `rename_exe`
options on that line are install-time concerns mise settles; Renovate only
moves the version string.
config:best-practices keeps the actions SHA-pinned with a trailing # vX.Y.Z
comment, which is the form `mise run pin-actions` already writes and the form
zizmor's unpinned-uses audit demands -- so a Renovate action bump stays green
through the pre-push hook without anyone re-running pinact by hand.
hk.pkl names its hk release twice per line -- once in the download URL
path (v1.55.0) and once in the pkl package coordinate (hk@1.55.0) -- across
both the `amends` and `import` lines, so four occurrences in total. hk
evaluates that file with its own embedded pkl and a config written against
one release is not guaranteed to evaluate under another, so these MUST move
in lockstep with `hk` in mise.toml; the packageRules entry below groups them
into a single PR. Two matchStrings rather than one because a regex manager
supports a single currentValue group per pattern, and each pattern is applied
to every occurrence in the file.
One PR for hk's two pins. `hk` comes from the mise manager reading
mise.toml; `jdx/hk` from the custom manager above reading hk.pkl. Split
across two PRs, either one merged alone leaves the binary and its config
on different releases -- which fails closed at `hk validate` rather than
silently, but still red on main for no reason.
Group the linters hk shells out to. They are only ever exercised together
by `hk check --all`, and each one's bump needs the same thing proven: that
a full lint pass over this tree is still clean. Separate PRs would each pay
for that same CI run. uv and pinact stay out of this group -- uv gates every
other job in CI, and pinact is a manual tool that touches no hook.
A new zizmor or actionlint release can add an audit that fires on a
workflow which was clean the day before, and a new ruff minor can add a
lint or change formatting. That is a real finding worth reading, not a
broken bot -- but it should never land unattended, and nothing here
automerges anyway. Kept as an explicit statement of that intent.
mise.toml's `[tools."http:blink"]` block is generated by
Scripts/update-blink-pin.sh and is content-addressed: the URL contains the
same SHA-256 as the checksum beside it, so a bump that edited one without the
other would produce a pin that cannot install. Renovate's mise manager ignores
the `http` backend today, so this is a no-op; it is here so that stays true if
that changes.
